summaryZh: Interactive Cognition Lab 为交互环境设计开展基础研究，研究分布式协作、交互与协调、人机交互、表示、电子学习和注意管理。项目包括增强视频、协作环境设计、上下文感知办公室及信息架构。
researchQuestions: 如何设计支持协作、注意管理和上下文感知的交互环境？
topics: 分布式协作与人机交互

evidence.quote: Interactive Cognition Lab Principal Investigator: David Kirsh
Interactive Cognition Lab We do basic research on the topics needed for designing interactive environments.
Distributed Collaboration, Interactivity, Coordination, Human Computer Interaction, Representation, E-Learning, Attention Management
Projects include: Augmented Video - how to add sound and annotation to share knowledge better Design of collaborative environments Context Aware Offices Elearning Information Architecture
